title: Make the Taiwan refresh receipt valid until the next official session closes

session_window_rule.freshness_condition: receipt_dt <= now_dt and (age <= max_refresh_age_seconds or receipt_dt >= latest_completed_official_session_close_utc)

changes: Implemented Taiwan refresh receipt session window in evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness in services/execution/market_snapshot_admission.py.
Preserved flat max_refresh_age_seconds window and enforced hard 14-day ceiling (MAX_TW_REFRESH_RECEIPT_AGE_SECONDS = 14 * 86400).
Derived completed session boundaries backwards from candidate session date using _tw_session_close_utc, skipping deterministic weekends and verified calendar holidays.
Ensured completed weekdays that cannot be verified fail closed and keep the receipt stale as market_input_stale_refresh.
Preserved all existing event-time staleness checks, lineage requirements, future-timestamp guards, and non-Taiwan admission logic unchanged.
Maintained max_refresh_age_seconds argument across all existing callers without inflating flat windows.

acceptance_status.1: met: evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness accepts a refresh receipt that is within max_refresh_age_seconds or that was taken at or after the close of the latest completed official session before now
acceptance_status.2: met: a receipt older than fourteen days (1209600s) is rejected as market_input_stale_refresh regardless of sessions or max_refresh_age_seconds
acceptance_status.3: met: sessions between the receipt and now are derived from the same weekday rule and validated governed calendar evidence used for event-time freshness; a completed weekday that cannot be verified keeps the receipt stale (market_input_stale_refresh)
acceptance_status.4: met: tests pin all four required cases: Friday 2026-10-16 close with Friday 07:00Z receipt is admitted on Monday 2026-10-19T02:00Z; rejected after Monday close; 2026-10-09 holiday with 2026-10-08 post-close receipt admitted on 2026-10-12T03:00Z; receipt before latest close rejected
acceptance_status.5: met: event-time staleness rules and every typed reason code are unchanged and non-Taiwan admission is unchanged
acceptance_status.6: met: all existing callers keep their max_refresh_age_seconds argument and their focused tests pass; no caller gets a larger flat window
acceptance_status.7: pending: exact reviewed head passes required checks and is merged to dev; hosted acceptance stays pending for the release coordinator
